# BAR Observatory

> A free, open-source, local-only flight recorder and deterministic audit-report generator for
> Claude Code AI agent sessions. Reads a session transcript already on disk, stores it in a local
> SQLite file, and renders a byte-identical report — no LLM in the render path, no network calls,
> no API key.

BAR Observatory (Base Agentic Reporter) turns an AI coding agent session into a receipt: every
tool call, task, sub-agent dispatch, rework loop, and error, with explicit absence states —
`not_recorded` for a channel with no rows, `not_observed` for a detector that isn't built yet —
rather than a fabricated zero. It also exposes the same data to
AI agents over a read-only MCP server, so a new session can check what a previous one already
tried before repeating it. Built by Bradley Ross; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): full technical overview — install, architecture, comparison, FAQ, MCP tools
- [Plain-language guide](wiki/human-md/README.md): no assumed background, click-along setup
- [AI agent guide](wiki/agent/AI-CONTEXT.md): MCP tool reference for an agent consuming this project
- [RUN.md](RUN.md): the command reference, three ways to install and run it
- [CRATES.md](CRATES.md): the 17-crate architecture, each crate's role and crates.io link

## Deeper reference

- [wiki/human-md/architecture.md](wiki/human-md/architecture.md): crate table, determinism contract, absence semantics, known limits
- [wiki/human-md/comparison.md](wiki/human-md/comparison.md): how this differs from live dashboards, OTel backends, and LLM eval platforms
- [wiki/human-md/enterprise.md](wiki/human-md/enterprise.md): offline/air-gapped use, what "local-only" actually guarantees
- [wiki/human-html/documentation-layers.html](wiki/human-html/documentation-layers.html): why this project's docs exist in three registers (human/AI/AISP), with a live tab switcher between them
- [wiki/human-html/report-guide.html](wiki/human-html/report-guide.html): section-by-section annotated walkthrough, quoting the shipped example report verbatim
- [wiki/aisp/HUB.aisp](wiki/aisp/HUB.aisp): machine-readable capability registry (AISP symbolic spec)
- [schemas/report.schema.json](schemas/report.schema.json): a versioned JSON contract for report.json -- currently out of sync with live output, disclosed as a known gap, not silently wrong

## Examples

- [examples/README.md](examples/README.md): what the four example reports are, and which of them the tool wrote
- [examples/deterministic/session.report.json](examples/deterministic/session.report.json): literally `bar report` output over the shipped capture -- also .html and .md
- [examples/deterministic/delivery-memo.html](examples/deterministic/delivery-memo.html): the same record cut for an executive reader (assembled from report.json + bar query, disclosed)
- [examples/interpreted/](examples/interpreted/): the optional LLM-written commentary layer, with the exact brief each page was written from
- [examples/capture/](examples/capture/): the seven session transcripts every figure is measured from, plus run.sh -- three commands reproduce the deterministic examples
- the project in the examples (`orbit`) is a stand-in: every count is measured by the tool from the shipped capture, the paths and names are demo values
